plan.summary: BRO-5857: resolve the 7 shows the cast-vs-reviews audit held. sticks-and-bones-1972 (1972 Broadway row) still lists 5 undated files reviewing the 2014 New Group off-Broadway revival, 4 of them scored; the date guard that flagged their 12 siblings never fired. Flag them wrongProduction. The Play That Goes Wrong and Magic Mike Live (West End long runs; reviews are of the row's own production) carry casts no review names; replace each with the performers its newest live reviews credit (2026 and 2025 reviews). Les Miserables and The Mousetrap keep their rows: those list a company newer than any review (checked against 2026 cast announcements), so the audit lists them as hand-checked with an expiry instead. Five more rows the audit only marked suspect carry a different production's cast (equus-west-end-2026, girl-interrupted-off-broadway-2026, avenue-q-west-end-2026, les-liaisons-dangereuses-west-end-2026, the-amazing-adventures-of-kavalier-and-clay-off-broadway-2025); replace those from their reviews too. Operation Mincemeat 2025 and Chicago 1996 need no data change: their rows list the IBDB current company and the reviews (all of the Broadway run) name the opening cast on file; the audit now recognises that. Also left: a 2016 McCarter (Princeton) review under the-mousetrap-west-end-2021 carries a human wrongProductionManualClear the plan path may not retract; the rebuild already leaves it unscored.
steps: Flag the 5 undated Sticks and Bones 2014 revival files wrongProduction with reason
Replace the cast on 2 West End long-run rows with the performers their newest reviews credit
Replace the cast on 5 rows whose cast belongs to a different production of the title (Equus, Girl, Interrupted, Avenue Q, Les Liaisons Dangereuses, Kavalier & Clay)
